Dress Code for The Company
The Company Employees are to keep a neat, clean, professional appearance at all times. Anyone
violating their Brand’s Dress code policy will be sent home to change into proper work attire and
may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and potentially including termination.

All Locations Dress Code:
Name tags
o Name tags are to be worn and visible at all times while working.

Anyone
violating their Brand’s Dress code policy will be sent home to change into proper work attire and
may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and potentially including termination.

All Locations Dress Code:
Name tags
o Name tags are to be worn and visible at all times while working. o Each Employee will receive one name tag. o Additional or replacement tags can be ordered through a manager at the Employee’s
expense. Shoes
o Tennis shoes or other full coverage closed toe shoes are to be worn. o No sandals, crocks, flip-flops, or other open toe shoes are allowed. o Shoes must be tied at all times and must be clean with no holes. Belts
o Belts are to be dark brown or black. o Belts are not to hang down or have objects (cell phones, pagers, chains, keys, etc.) hanging
from them. Hair
o Hair of all lengths and colors are acceptable as long as it is clean, groomed, and kept out of
employee’s face and eyes.

Facial Hair
o Facial hair is acceptable as long as it is clean, well-groomed, and trimmed. Make-up
o Due to the nature of working in the Beauty Industry, reasonable and natural make-up is
acceptable and encouraged. Jewelry/Accessories
o Jewelry that does not interfere with work is acceptable. o No dangling earrings or chains, and no pins or buttons allowed on the shirt unless approved
by Management. Tattoos
o Large, inappropriate, or offensive tattoos must be covered. All other tattoos are acceptable
as long as they are not discriminatory or offensive in nature. Crunch Fitness Specific Dress Code:
Shirts
o Two uniform shirts will be provided to all Employees upon hire. o Full-time Employees will receive an additional 1-2 shirts. o Employee may also wear a plain black, white, or gray long sleeve shirt underneath their
branded shirt when cold. o Group Fitness Instructors (Crunch Fitness) teaching classes that are not proprietary to
Crunch Fitness, i.e., Zumba, Pound, etc. may wear fitness style apparel or branding related
to class style. o Shirts should not be shorter than the beltline, exposing the stomach area or low cut to
expose the chest area. o Shirts must be clean and free of wrinkles. o No patches, rips, or holes are to be noticeable on the shirt. Pants
o Yoga pants, joggers, or sweats are approved for Instructors ONLY (preferably solid black). o Front Desk and Management’s pants must be solid khaki or black in color. o Pants must be full length and free of holes or frayed edges.

Cell Phone/Smart Watch Policy
Personal Employee cell phones are permitted in the workplace but must be kept out of sight. It
is the Employee’s personal responsibility to protect the customer’s experience and doing things
such as texting, making phone calls or using social media jeopardizes the customer’s experience.
